verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a pricing-page line item listing "Call Intelligence & sequences" as a plan feature, plus an AI claim about drafting follow-ups. This suggests sequences exist, likely on a specific tier, but there is no documentation of how they work. Missing for 10: documentation of multi-step sequence configuration, email templates, sending from inside the CRM to prospects, tier availability details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
